messages:
Cora: Ok team — finalizing the webinar run for next Thurs. Topic idea: 'Practical cost & latency wins with next-gen inference' — quick thumbs?
Miles: love it. can we make the hook more customer-y? e.g., 'How we cut per-conversation cost by 3x without losing quality'
Cora: yes — keeping that angle. Jasmine, can you draft a 2-sentence abstract for the registration page?
Jasmine: draft incoming: 'Join Redwood engineers and customers to see real end-to-end strategies for slashing inference costs while keeping latency tight. Demos + benchmark narratives, plus a live Q&A on routing, caching, and quantization choices.' Thoughts?
Tom: sounds good. can we call out a concrete demo like 'chat support at 200 RPS' so it feels real.
Cora: good call. update: include 'live demo: customer chat at 200 RPS, sub-150ms p95'
Andy: speakers: Cora (product), Tom (runtime eng), Miles (customer/CS), Jasmine (moderator). Need to confirm one customer—Miles can you invite the Dovetail contact?
Miles: pinged Dovetail PM, they said yes in principle, pending rehearsal availability.
Cora: rehearsal schedule — propose: tech check Tue 11am, full run Wed 3pm (dry run with slides + demo). OpsBot can you schedule calendar invites for those slots?
OpsBot: Rehearsal events created: Tech check Tue 11:00-11:30, Dry run Wed 15:00-16:00. Invites sent to Cora, Miles, Jasmine, Tom, Andy.
Tom: tech checklist: 1) demo infra on dedicated pool, 2) model pinned to v1.2-quant, 3) ingress routed to canary for demo only, 4) recording enabled. I'll paste the commands on the tech check.
Tom: demo snippet to run during tech check: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-quant-v1.2","input":"hello"}'` — will show token/perf counters live.
Jasmine: run-of-show draft (30m): 0-5m intros; 5-12m benchmarks + narrative; 12-22m live demo; 22-28m customer story; 28-30m Q&A wrap + CTA. Keep Qs to chat for live routing.
Cora: agree. we should add a 1-slide fallback plan in case demo fails (video of the demo + recorded metrics). Tom please prepare 2-min fallback video.
Miles: lead routing — important. Configure registration form with company size + interest tag (POC, enterprise, dev). Route POC leads to SDR queue, enterprise to AE queue, dev to self-serve nurture. Jasmine can you confirm the funnel copy?
Jasmine: yes — will add hidden field `webinar_interest` values: ["poc","enterprise","dev"]. Set webhook to /marketing/webhooks/webinar and include UTM tags.
Andy: make sure we have the replay landing page ready 1 hour after event and include short form for 'Talk to sales'. Ops, set TTL for recording asset retention = 90 days.
Cora: marketing assets: 1) one-sentence social post, 2) banner for registration, 3) three takeaways slide. Assign: Jasmine social + copy, Miles customer quote, Andy landing + tracking.
Miles: I'll get customer quote + a quick blurb from Dovetail.
Tom: can someone add a prometheus graph to the demo slide showing p95 latency? will pull metrics during tech check and snapshot.
Jasmine: we should rehearse how we answer cost questions — quick FAQ doc in the rehearsal. I'll draft 5 Qs (pricing, SLA, private deploy, model fidelity, fallback behavior).
Cora: thanks. last asks: update registration page by Friday EOD, finalize slides by Wed noon, video fallback uploaded before tech check. Anything else?
Tom: I'll bring the demo infra checklist to tech check.
Miles: will confirm customer availability by EOD tomorrow.
Andy: I'll run the GA tracking test after registration update.
Cora: perfect. :thumbsup:
